title_original: 지방교육행정기관의 행정기구와 정원기준 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Rule No. 139, February 29, 2012>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2013.

Article 2 (Relationship to Other Statutes or Regulations)
Where, as at the time these Rules enter into force, another statute or regulation cites the former Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on Organizations and Personnel Standards of Local Educational Administrative Agencies or any provision thereof, and these Rules contain a corresponding provision, the reference shall be deemed to refer to these Rules or the corresponding provision hereof in lieu of the former Rules or provision.
